feature: Stage J P0 Native Salvage vs RESCUE Escrow Atomic Arbitration
prerequisites: Authorized throwaway copy of persistent evejs-data; never modify live world
Real original NPC hauler death, source-tagged wreck, two authenticated characters and native NPC rival with stock loot rights
Manual local Node baseline and overlay --dry-run; no GitHub Actions

scenarios.name: NPC first, stale player quote
actions: Present original real wreck to both pilot and NPC
After signed pair quote but before reserve's SQLite transaction allow rival's atomic pickup
Attempt corporation escrow reserve
scenarios.expected: NPC cargo credited once, exact wreck row gone, no player escrow debited, no paid contract

scenarios.name: Player escrow first, stale NPC preflight
actions: Two real pilots accept and atomically reserve from genuine wallet
Allow rival to rely on stale NOT_FOUND escrow preflight and attempt native pickup
scenarios.expected: Rival pickup denied within GameStore transaction; original native wreck row remains; only one corporate debit

scenarios.name: Genuine unfunded rival recovery
actions: Make original native wreck available with no escrow or player receipt
Allow legal same-corporation rival to physically approach and collect
scenarios.expected: One atomic wreck debit and native NPC cargo credit plus rival receipt; no player ISK payout

scenarios.name: Reject forged restored wreck
actions: On disposable copy only, simulate an already durable rival pickup receipt with a subsequently restored apparent original wreck row
Attempt new player escrow reserve
scenarios.expected: No new escrow or funds debited; receipt takes precedence over apparent stock

scenarios.name: Crash before commit
actions: Inject crash before SQLite COMMIT for one of two competing paths
Restart from same native persisted GameStore
scenarios.expected: No partial item/wallet movement; one original custodian and no duplicated ISK

scenarios.name: ACK lost after commit
actions: Inject lost ACK immediately after SQLite COMMIT for reserve or rival pickup
Re-open same signed contract and replay via server
Inspect native GameStore escrow, wreck, NPC cargo and receipt
scenarios.expected: Committed outcome reconciles from durable rows; no second escrow or item creation

scenarios.name: Funded RESCUE full delivery
actions: Ensure player-funded path wins
Two independent pilots fly to wreck, carry original item, physically dock and deliver
Verify final payout and replay after reconnect
scenarios.expected: One original item in corporation warehouse and exactly one wallet credit per pilot

scenarios.name: Terminal or corrupt escrow
actions: Present REFUNDED or malformed existing escrow records
Attempt automatic NPC rival salvage on otherwise available original wreck
scenarios.expected: No rival pickup; source stays reserved for operator reconciliation

scenarios.name: Safety default OFF
actions: Keep ALIFE rival and native transaction flags unset on pinned world
Observe A-Life normal scheduler
scenarios.expected: No new rival native pickup or ISK mutation

scenarios.name: Post-delivery NPC stock turnover
actions: Complete a paid RESCUE with real delivery and one settlement
Allow legal NPC trade or consumption of stocked item
Reconnect and inspect player history
scenarios.expected: Paid rescue and earned reputation remain backed by durable settlement proof; no new ISK

scenarios.name: Original cargo type changes between preflight and COMMIT
actions: On a disposable native GameStore copy, stage a legal original wreck that passes NPC rival preflight
Before rival SQLite COMMIT replace original wreck sourceKind with non-cargo loot
Attempt the native rival pickup
scenarios.expected: Fail closed inside native transaction, no NPC cargo credit, no original source debit, no ISK
